orgs.name: Biodesign Challenge
orgs.description: An international programme in which art, design and science students spend a semester designing projects with biotechnology, culminating in an annual summit and prizes.
orgs.description_zh: 面向艺术、设计与科学专业学生的国际项目：学生用一个学期以生物技术为材料做设计，每年在峰会上展示并评奖。

orgs.name: Biofabricate
orgs.description: Founded by Suzanne Lee, Biofabricate runs an annual summit and industry network for materials grown by living organisms, plus a biomaterials learning site.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Suzanne Lee 创办，每年举办峰会，并运营一个面向生物生长材料的产业网络和生物材料学习网站。

orgs.name: MaterialDriven
orgs.description: A London material consultancy, gallery and online library that promotes new, often bio-based and waste-derived materials to designers and brands.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的材料咨询机构，同时有展厅和线上材料库，向设计师和品牌推广新材料，其中许多是生物基材料或由废料制成。

orgs.name: MaterialDistrict
orgs.description: An online platform and yearly fair in Rotterdam that catalogues innovative materials, including a large section on bio-based and grown materials.
orgs.description_zh: 在线材料平台，每年在鹿特丹办展会，收录各类创新材料，其中生物基和生长材料占很大比例。

orgs.name: Future Materials Bank
orgs.description: An open online database of sustainable and experimental materials made by artists and designers, initiated by the Jan van Eyck Academie in Maastricht.
orgs.description_zh: 开放的在线数据库，收录艺术家和设计师开发的可持续与实验性材料，由马斯特里赫特的 Jan van Eyck Academie 发起。

orgs.name: Materiom
orgs.description: An open-data platform that publishes recipes and property data for biomaterials made from locally abundant biomass, so communities can make and test them.
orgs.description_zh: 开放数据平台，公开用本地丰富生物质制作生物材料的配方和性能数据，方便各地社区自行制作和测试。

orgs.name: Biohm
orgs.description: A research-led company that grows mycelium insulation and makes building panels from food waste for a circular construction industry.
orgs.description_zh: 以研究为主导的公司，用菌丝体生长保温材料、用食物垃圾制作建筑板材，服务于循环建筑业。

orgs.name: Design & Living Systems Lab (Central Saint Martins)
orgs.description: A research lab at Central Saint Martins led by Carole Collet that explores how biology and biotechnology can shape sustainable design futures.
orgs.description_zh: 中央圣马丁学院由 Carole Collet 领导的研究实验室，探索生物学和生物技术如何塑造可持续的设计未来。

orgs.name: MA Biodesign (Central Saint Martins)
orgs.description: A master's course at Central Saint Martins where students work with living systems, wet labs and scientists to design regenerative products and materials.
orgs.description_zh: 中央圣马丁学院的硕士课程，学生在湿实验室里与科学家合作，以活体系统设计再生性的产品与材料。

orgs.name: MA Art and Science (Central Saint Martins)
orgs.description: A master's course at Central Saint Martins for artists who work across art and scientific research, including biology and ecology.
orgs.description_zh: 中央圣马丁学院的硕士课程，面向在艺术与科学研究（包括生物学和生态学）之间工作的艺术家。

orgs.name: Mediated Matter (MIT Media Lab)
orgs.description: Neri Oxman's former MIT Media Lab group, which designed with silkworms, bacteria and biopolymers and coined 'material ecology'; its archive stays online.
orgs.description_zh: Neri Oxman 在 MIT 媒体实验室的原研究组，与蚕、细菌和生物聚合物一起做设计，提出“材料生态学”；项目档案仍在线。

orgs.name: OXMAN
orgs.description: Neri Oxman's New York design company that builds products, architecture and systems with and for nature, continuing her material ecology work.
orgs.description_zh: Neri Oxman 在纽约创办的设计公司，与自然一起、为自然设计产品、建筑和系统，延续她的材料生态学研究。

orgs.name: Sculpting Evolution (MIT Media Lab)
orgs.description: Kevin Esvelt's MIT Media Lab group, which develops gene-drive and ecological engineering tools and argues for community-led, open decisions about them.
orgs.description_zh: Kevin Esvelt 在 MIT 媒体实验室的研究组，开发基因驱动和生态工程工具，并主张由社区公开参与相关决策。

orgs.name: Community Biotechnology Initiative (MIT Media Lab)
orgs.description: An MIT Media Lab initiative that supports community biology labs worldwide and convenes the Global Community Bio Summit.
orgs.description_zh: MIT 媒体实验室的项目，支持全球的社区生物实验室，并召集“全球社区生物峰会”。

orgs.name: Wyss Institute for Biologically Inspired Engineering (Harvard)
orgs.description: Harvard's institute that turns biological principles into technologies, from organs-on-chips and DNA nanotech to engineered living materials.
orgs.description_zh: 哈佛大学的研究所，把生物学原理转化为技术，涵盖器官芯片、DNA 纳米技术和工程化活体材料等。

orgs.name: Complex Materials Lab (ETH Zurich)
orgs.description: André Studart's lab at ETH Zurich that develops bio-inspired and living materials, including 3D-printed bacteria-laden and self-healing materials.
orgs.description_zh: André Studart 在苏黎世联邦理工学院的实验室，研发仿生材料和活体材料，包括含细菌的 3D 打印材料和自修复材料。

orgs.name: Biobased Creations
orgs.description: A Dutch design agency that makes exhibitions and pavilions (such as the Embassy of Circular & Biobased Building) to show bio-based materials to the public.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰设计机构，通过展览和展馆（如“循环与生物基建筑大使馆”）向公众展示生物基材料。

orgs.name: Fabricademy
orgs.description: A distributed textile and technology course across the Fab Lab network, covering biofabricated materials, bio-dyes and wearables.
orgs.description_zh: 分布在 Fab Lab 网络中的纺织与技术课程，内容包括生物制造材料、生物染料和可穿戴设备。

orgs.name: Fab Lab Barcelona (IAAC)
orgs.description: IAAC's digital fabrication lab, a hub of the global Fab Lab network, with research on distributed manufacturing, biomaterials and Fab City.
orgs.description_zh: IAAC 的数字制造实验室，是全球 Fab Lab 网络的枢纽之一，研究分布式制造、生物材料和 Fab City。

orgs.name: Valldaura Labs (IAAC)
orgs.description: IAAC's self-sufficient research campus in the Collserola forest, where students test bio-based construction, food and energy systems on site.
orgs.description_zh: IAAC 位于 Collserola 森林中的自给自足研究园区，学生在现场试验生物基建造、食物和能源系统。

orgs.name: TextileLab Amsterdam (Waag)
orgs.description: Waag's open lab for textiles, where designers experiment with natural dyes, bacterial colour and grown materials.
orgs.description_zh: Waag 的开放纺织实验室，设计师在这里试验天然染料、细菌色素和生长材料。

orgs.name: Open Wetlab (Waag)
orgs.description: Waag's public biology lab where artists, designers and citizens work hands-on with biotechnology and discuss its social questions.
orgs.description_zh: Waag 的公共生物实验室，艺术家、设计师和市民在这里亲手操作生物技术，并讨论其社会问题。

orgs.name: Waag Futurelab
orgs.description: An Amsterdam research institute for technology and society that runs open labs (Open Wetlab, TextileLab, FabLab) and public programmes on biotech and ecology.
orgs.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的技术与社会研究机构，运营 Open Wetlab、TextileLab、FabLab 等开放实验室，并举办生物技术与生态主题的公共项目。

orgs.name: BioHack Academy (Waag)
orgs.description: A Waag course in which participants build their own open-source biolab equipment and learn to grow and engineer organisms.
orgs.description_zh: Waag 开设的课程，学员自己动手制作开源生物实验室设备，并学习培养和改造生物。

orgs.name: Ecovative
orgs.description: A pioneer of mycelium materials that grows packaging, foams and alternative meats from fungal mycelium and licenses the process.
orgs.description_zh: 菌丝体材料的先行者，用真菌菌丝体生长包装、泡沫材料和替代肉，并对外授权工艺。

orgs.name: Modern Meadow
orgs.description: A biotech company that designs protein-based materials for fashion and beauty, first known for lab-grown leather.
orgs.description_zh: 以蛋白质为基础设计时尚与美妆材料的生物技术公司，最早以实验室培育皮革闻名。

orgs.name: Bolt Threads
orgs.description: A materials company known for bioengineered spider silk protein and the mycelium leather Mylo, now focused on bio-based beauty ingredients.
orgs.description_zh: 以生物工程蜘蛛丝蛋白和菌丝体皮革 Mylo 闻名的材料公司，现主要做生物基美妆成分。

orgs.name: Spiber
orgs.description: A Japanese company that ferments structural proteins inspired by spider silk and turns them into fibres for textiles and other products.
orgs.description_zh: 日本公司，受蜘蛛丝启发，通过发酵生产结构蛋白，并把它们做成纺织纤维等产品。

orgs.name: AMSilk
orgs.description: A German biotech company that produces spider-silk proteins by fermentation for textiles, cosmetics and medical coatings.
orgs.description_zh: 德国生物技术公司，通过发酵生产蜘蛛丝蛋白，用于纺织、化妆品和医疗涂层。

orgs.name: Colorifix
orgs.description: A company that uses engineered microbes to produce and fix dyes on textiles, cutting the water and chemicals used in dyeing.
orgs.description_zh: 利用工程微生物生产染料并把颜色固定在织物上的公司，减少染色过程的用水和化学品。

orgs.name: Living Ink Technologies
orgs.description: A company that makes printing inks and pigments from algae, starting with a carbon-negative black ink.
orgs.description_zh: 用藻类制作印刷油墨和颜料的公司，首个产品是碳负排放的黑色油墨。
orgs.based_zh: 奥罗拉（科罗拉多州），美国

orgs.name: Pili
orgs.description: A French company, born from La Paillasse, that combines fermentation and chemistry to make bio-based dyes and pigments.
orgs.description_zh: 诞生于 La Paillasse 社区的法国公司，结合发酵与化学工艺生产生物基染料和颜料。

orgs.name: Huue
orgs.description: A startup that uses engineered microbes to make indigo and other textile dyes without petrochemicals or toxic reducing agents.
orgs.description_zh: 初创公司，用工程微生物生产靛蓝等纺织染料，不需要石化原料和有毒还原剂。

orgs.name: Faber Futures
orgs.description: Natsai Audrey Chieza's biodesign studio, known for dyeing textiles with Streptomyces bacteria and for strategy work on biotech and design.
orgs.description_zh: Natsai Audrey Chieza 的生物设计工作室，以用链霉菌给织物染色闻名，也为生物技术与设计提供战略咨询。

orgs.name: Modern Synthesis
orgs.description: A London company that grows textile materials with bacteria that weave nanocellulose onto yarn frameworks.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦公司，让细菌把纳米纤维素“织”在纱线骨架上，生长出纺织材料。

orgs.name: Biomason
orgs.description: A company that grows cement tiles and building products with bacteria at ambient temperature instead of kiln-fired cement.
orgs.description_zh: 公司在常温下用细菌生长水泥砖和建筑产品，代替高温烧制的水泥。
orgs.based_zh: 达勒姆（北卡罗来纳州），美国

orgs.name: Prometheus Materials
orgs.description: A spin-out from the University of Colorado that makes low-carbon concrete blocks using microalgae-grown biocement.
orgs.description_zh: 科罗拉多大学的衍生公司，用微藻生长的生物水泥制造低碳混凝土砌块。
orgs.based_zh: 朗蒙特（科罗拉多州），美国

orgs.name: Mogu
orgs.description: An Italian company that grows acoustic panels and flooring from fungal mycelium and agricultural residues.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利公司，用真菌菌丝体和农业废料生长吸音板和地板。

orgs.name: Made of Air
orgs.description: A Berlin company that turns biomass into biochar-based thermoplastics that lock carbon into facades, furniture and cars.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林公司，把生物质制成以生物炭为基础的热塑性材料，将碳封存在建筑立面、家具和汽车中。

orgs.name: Grown.bio
orgs.description: A Dutch company that grows mycelium packaging and materials and licenses its process to local producers.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰公司，生长菌丝体包装和材料，并把工艺授权给当地生产者。

orgs.name: Keel Labs
orgs.description: A company, formerly AlgiKnit, that spins yarns from kelp-based alginate for knitwear and textiles.
orgs.description_zh: 原名 AlgiKnit 的公司，用海带提取的海藻酸盐纺纱，用于针织和纺织品。
orgs.based_zh: 达勒姆（北卡罗来纳州），美国

orgs.name: Blast Studio
orgs.description: A London design studio that 3D-prints objects and columns from mycelium grown on waste such as used coffee cups.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦设计工作室，用在废弃咖啡杯等垃圾上生长的菌丝体 3D 打印物件和柱子。

orgs.name: Officina Corpuscoli
orgs.description: Maurizio Montalti's design and research studio that works with fungi and other living systems to rethink materials and production.
orgs.description_zh: Maurizio Montalti 的设计研究工作室，与真菌等活体系统合作，重新思考材料与生产。

orgs.name: Post Carbon Lab
orgs.description: A London textile research lab that develops photosynthetic coatings and microbial dyes for garments.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦纺织研究实验室，开发用于服装的光合作用涂层和微生物染料。

orgs.name: Glowee
orgs.description: A French company that makes light from bioluminescent marine bacteria for public lighting and installations.
orgs.description_zh: 法国公司，用海洋发光细菌制造光源，用于公共照明和装置。

orgs.name: Light Bio
orgs.description: A company that sells genetically engineered glowing plants, starting with the Firefly Petunia, using a fungal bioluminescence pathway.
orgs.description_zh: 销售转基因发光植物的公司，首款产品为 Firefly Petunia，利用了真菌的生物发光通路。

orgs.name: Notpla
orgs.description: A London company that makes packaging from seaweed and plants, including edible drink pods and coatings for takeaway boxes.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦公司，用海藻和植物制作包装，包括可食用饮料胶囊和外卖盒涂层。

orgs.name: Biomimicry Institute
orgs.description: A nonprofit that teaches designers to learn from nature's strategies, runs the Ray of Hope Prize and publishes AskNature.
orgs.description_zh: 非营利组织，教设计师向自然的策略学习，运营 Ray of Hope 奖并出版 AskNature 数据库。

orgs.name: AskNature
orgs.description: The Biomimicry Institute's free online library of biological strategies and bio-inspired designs, searchable by function.
orgs.description_zh: Biomimicry Institute 的免费在线库，收录生物策略与仿生设计案例，可按功能检索。

orgs.name: ecoLogicStudio
orgs.description: An architecture and urban design studio that builds photobioreactors and algae-based structures that capture carbon in cities.
orgs.description_zh: 建筑与城市设计工作室，建造光生物反应器和藻类结构，在城市中捕获碳。

orgs.name: Terreform ONE
orgs.description: A nonprofit architecture and ecological design lab in New York that builds prototypes with mycelium, living plants and animal habitats.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约的非营利建筑与生态设计实验室，用菌丝体、活植物和动物栖息地做原型。

orgs.name: The Nature Lab (RISD)
orgs.description: Rhode Island School of Design's natural-history collection and biology lab, where art and design students study specimens and work with living systems.
orgs.description_zh: 罗德岛设计学院的自然史收藏和生物实验室，艺术与设计学生在这里研究标本并与活体系统合作。

orgs.name: CHEMARTS (Aalto University)
orgs.description: An Aalto University collaboration between chemistry and design students that develops new uses for wood-based and other biomaterials.
orgs.description_zh: 阿尔托大学化学与设计学生的合作项目，为木基及其他生物材料开发新用途。

orgs.name: Centre for Materials Science & Culture (RCA)
orgs.description: A Royal College of Art research centre that brings designers and material scientists together, including work on bio-based and living materials.
orgs.description_zh: 英国皇家艺术学院的研究中心，把设计师和材料科学家聚在一起，研究内容包括生物基材料和活体材料。

orgs.name: BlueCity
orgs.description: A circular-economy hub in a former Rotterdam swimming pool that hosts biomaterial startups and the BlueCity Lab for material experiments.
orgs.description_zh: 位于鹿特丹一座旧泳池里的循环经济中心，入驻多家生物材料初创公司，并设有做材料实验的 BlueCity Lab。

orgs.name: BioArt Laboratories
orgs.description: Jalila Essaïdi's Eindhoven foundation that links art, science and industry, known for projects such as bulletproof skin and circular manure materials.
orgs.description_zh: Jalila Essaïdi 在埃因霍温创办的基金会，连接艺术、科学与产业，代表项目有“防弹皮肤”和粪肥循环材料。

orgs.name: Nieuwe Instituut
orgs.description: The Dutch national institute for architecture, design and digital culture, whose research and exhibitions have covered biobased design and more-than-human perspectives.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰国家建筑、设计与数字文化机构，其研究和展览涉及生物基设计和超越人类的视角。

orgs.name: Material Innovation Initiative
orgs.description: A nonprofit think tank that publishes research and market reports on next-generation, animal-free materials such as mycelium and microbial leathers.
orgs.description_zh: 非营利智库，发布关于新一代无动物材料（如菌丝体和微生物皮革）的研究和市场报告。

orgs.name: New Harvest
orgs.description: A nonprofit research institute that funds open, public research in cellular agriculture, growing animal products from cell cultures.
orgs.description_zh: 非营利研究机构，资助细胞农业（用细胞培养生产动物产品）领域的开放公共研究。

orgs.name: Biotechnology Design (Cambridge University Press)
orgs.description: An open-access journal, formerly Research Directions: Biotechnology Design, that publishes research at the meeting point of design and biotechnology.
orgs.description_zh: 开放获取期刊，原名 Research Directions: Biotechnology Design，发表设计与生物技术交叉领域的研究。

orgs.name: BioDesigned
orgs.description: An online magazine from the Biodesign Challenge community with essays, interviews and news on biology in design, art and industry.
orgs.description_zh: Biodesign Challenge 社群的在线杂志，刊发关于设计、艺术和产业中生物学的文章、访谈与新闻。

orgs.name: Materiability Research Network
orgs.description: Manuel Kretzer's educational platform and network on smart and biological materials, with open tutorials and student projects.
orgs.description_zh: Manuel Kretzer 创办的教育平台与网络，关注智能材料和生物材料，提供开放教程和学生项目。

orgs.name: Institute for Computational Design and Construction (University of Stuttgart)
orgs.description: Achim Menges' institute that develops biomimetic, computationally designed architecture, including fibre pavilions modelled on beetle shells and spider webs.
orgs.description_zh: Achim Menges 领导的研究所，研究仿生的计算设计建筑，包括模仿甲虫壳和蜘蛛网的纤维展亭。

orgs.name: Living Architecture (EU project)
orgs.description: An EU-funded project that built microbial fuel cell bioreactor walls able to clean water, make electricity and respond to occupants.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟资助的项目，建造了由微生物燃料电池构成的生物反应墙，可以净化水、发电并回应使用者。

orgs.name: GROW by Ginkgo
orgs.description: Ginkgo Bioworks' magazine of essays, fiction and art on biotechnology and its futures, commissioned from writers and artists.
orgs.description_zh: Ginkgo Bioworks 出版的杂志，委约作家和艺术家撰写关于生物技术及其未来的文章、小说和艺术作品。

orgs.name: MYCL (Mycotech Lab)
orgs.description: An Indonesian company that grows Mylea mycelium leather and binderless boards from agricultural waste.
orgs.description_zh: 印度尼西亚公司，用农业废料生长 Mylea 菌丝皮革和无胶板材。

orgs.name: SymbioticA (University of Western Australia)
orgs.description: The first research lab where artists work hands-on in a biology department, known for the Tissue Culture & Art Project and its artist residencies; its website is now archived.
orgs.description_zh: 第一个让艺术家在生物系里亲手做实验的研究室，以“组织培养与艺术项目”和艺术家驻留闻名；网站现已存档。

orgs.name: MU Hybrid Art House
orgs.description: An Eindhoven art house that shows work at the edge of art, design and technology, with many exhibitions on biotech and nature, and co-runs the Bio Art & Design Award.
orgs.description_zh: 埃因霍温的艺术机构，展示艺术、设计与技术交界处的作品，常办生物技术与自然主题展览，并联合主办 Bio Art & Design Award。

orgs.name: Bio Art & Design Award (BAD Award)
orgs.description: A Dutch award that pairs young artists and designers with Dutch life-science labs, funding new works shown at MU Hybrid Art House.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰奖项，让年轻艺术家和设计师与荷兰生命科学实验室结对，资助新作品并在 MU Hybrid Art House 展出。

orgs.name: Art Laboratory Berlin
orgs.description: A Berlin art space and research platform for art at the intersection of the life sciences and technology, with exhibitions, conferences and a DIY lab.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的艺术空间和研究平台，关注艺术与生命科学、技术的交汇，举办展览、会议并设有 DIY 实验室。

orgs.name: Kapelica Gallery
orgs.description: A Ljubljana gallery for contemporary investigative art, among the first to show bio art, robotics and body-based work.
orgs.description_zh: 卢布尔雅那的当代探索性艺术画廊，是最早展出生物艺术、机器人艺术和身体艺术的机构之一。
orgs.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚

orgs.name: Biotehna
orgs.description: An open platform run with Kapelica Gallery for artistic research into living systems, with a shared lab, workshops and residencies.
orgs.description_zh: 与 Kapelica 画廊一起运营的开放平台，支持对活体系统的艺术研究，提供共享实验室、工作坊和驻留。
orgs.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚

orgs.name: Ars Electronica
orgs.description: A Linz festival, museum and lab for art, technology and society whose yearly festival regularly features bio art, synthetic biology and living-machine work.
orgs.description_zh: 位于林茨的艺术、技术与社会节展、博物馆和实验室，每年的艺术节常展出生物艺术、合成生物学和活体机器作品。

orgs.name: Prix Ars Electronica
orgs.description: A long-running media-art competition whose Hybrid Art and Artificial Life & Intelligence categories have recognised many key bio art works.
orgs.description_zh: 历史悠久的媒体艺术奖项，其“混合艺术”和“人工生命与智能”类别表彰过许多重要的生物艺术作品。

orgs.name: S+T+ARTS Prize
orgs.description: A European Commission prize run by Ars Electronica for collaborations between science, technology and the arts, often won by bio-based projects.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟委员会委托 Ars Electronica 运营的奖项，表彰科学、技术与艺术的合作，获奖者中不少是生物相关项目。

orgs.name: S+T+ARTS
orgs.description: The European Commission's Science, Technology and the Arts initiative, which funds residencies, prizes and regional centres pairing artists with researchers.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟委员会的“科学、技术与艺术”计划，资助驻留、奖项和区域中心，让艺术家与研究者合作。

orgs.name: Ars Electronica Futurelab
orgs.description: Ars Electronica's research and development lab, which works with artists and companies on art-driven projects in AI, robotics and life sciences.
orgs.description_zh: Ars Electronica 的研发实验室，与艺术家和企业合作开展以艺术为导向的人工智能、机器人和生命科学项目。

orgs.name: Science Gallery Network
orgs.description: A network of university-linked galleries (Atlanta, Bengaluru, London, Melbourne, Monterrey and others) that show art-science exhibitions for young adults.
orgs.description_zh: 由大学支持的画廊网络（亚特兰大、班加罗尔、伦敦、墨尔本、蒙特雷等），面向年轻人举办艺术与科学展览。

orgs.name: Bioart Society (SOLU)
orgs.description: A Helsinki association that supports art about life sciences and ecology, runs the SOLU space and the Ars Bioarctica residency at the Kilpisjärvi field station.
orgs.description_zh: 赫尔辛基的协会，支持关于生命科学与生态的艺术，运营 SOLU 空间和位于 Kilpisjärvi 野外站的 Ars Bioarctica 驻留。

orgs.name: Cultivamos Cultura
orgs.description: Marta de Menezes' rural art-science centre in Portugal that hosts residencies, a biolab and workshops on bio art.
orgs.description_zh: Marta de Menezes 在葡萄牙乡村创办的艺术与科学中心，提供驻留、生物实验室和生物艺术工作坊。

orgs.name: Center for Genomic Gastronomy
orgs.description: An artist-led research group that studies the biotechnologies and biodiversity of human food systems through exhibitions, meals and publications.
orgs.description_zh: 由艺术家主导的研究团体，通过展览、餐食和出版物研究人类食物系统中的生物技术和生物多样性。

orgs.name: Leonardo / ISAST
orgs.description: A nonprofit that publishes the journal Leonardo (MIT Press) and runs LASER talks, a key forum for art-science including bio art since 1968.
orgs.description_zh: 非营利组织，出版 Leonardo 期刊（MIT Press）并举办 LASER 讲座，自 1968 年起是艺术与科学（包括生物艺术）的重要论坛。

orgs.name: SciArt Initiative
orgs.description: A nonprofit that connects scientists and artists through residencies, open calls, exhibitions and an online community.
orgs.description_zh: 非营利组织，通过驻留、公开征集、展览和线上社群把科学家与艺术家联系起来。

orgs.name: SciArt Magazine
orgs.description: An online magazine that covers artists working with science, publishing interviews and themed monthly issues.
orgs.description_zh: 报道与科学合作的艺术家的在线杂志，按月发布主题刊和访谈。

orgs.name: Wellcome Collection
orgs.description: A free London museum and library about health and life, whose exhibitions often commission artists working with biology and medicine.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的免费博物馆和图书馆，主题是健康与生命，其展览常委托与生物学和医学合作的艺术家。

orgs.name: Biofriction
orgs.description: A European project by Hangar, Kapelica Gallery, Bioart Society and Cultivamos Cultura that ran residencies and events on bio art and citizen biotech; the site is archived.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Hangar、Kapelica 画廊、Bioart Society 和 Cultivamos Cultura 合作的欧洲项目，举办生物艺术和公民生物技术的驻留与活动；网站已存档。

orgs.name: BIOTOPIA
orgs.description: A new natural history and life sciences museum in Munich that runs festivals, labs and exhibitions linking art, design and biology.
orgs.description_zh: 慕尼黑正在建设的自然史与生命科学博物馆，举办连接艺术、设计与生物学的节展、实验室和展览。

orgs.name: BIO – Biennial of Design Ljubljana
orgs.description: One of Europe's oldest design biennials, run by the Museum of Architecture and Design, whose recent editions focus on ecology, food and living materials.
orgs.description_zh: 欧洲历史最悠久的设计双年展之一，由建筑与设计博物馆主办，近年各届聚焦生态、食物和活体材料。
orgs.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚

orgs.name: Arts Catalyst
orgs.description: A UK arts organisation that commissions art engaging with science and ecology, from space biology to environmental justice.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术机构，委约与科学和生态对话的艺术作品，题材从太空生物学到环境正义。

orgs.name: Schering Stiftung
orgs.description: A Berlin foundation that supports art and science, including exhibitions and awards for artists working with the life sciences.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的基金会，支持艺术与科学，为与生命科学合作的艺术家提供展览和奖项。

orgs.name: Art|Sci Center (UCLA)
orgs.description: Victoria Vesna's centre at UCLA that brings artists and scientists together through courses, exhibitions and events on biology and nanotech.
orgs.description_zh: Victoria Vesna 在加州大学洛杉矶分校创办的中心，通过课程、展览和活动让艺术家与科学家在生物学和纳米技术领域合作。

orgs.name: SVA Bio Art Lab
orgs.description: A biology lab inside the School of Visual Arts where art students work with living matter, founded by bio art pioneer Suzanne Anker.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约视觉艺术学院内的生物实验室，艺术学生在这里与活体材料合作，由生物艺术先驱 Suzanne Anker 创办。

orgs.name: Lifepatch
orgs.description: A citizen initiative in art, science and technology in Yogyakarta that runs DIY biology, water monitoring and fermentation projects with local communities.
orgs.description_zh: 日惹的艺术、科学与技术公民组织，与当地社区开展 DIY 生物、水质监测和发酵项目。

orgs.name: HONF Foundation (House of Natural Fiber)
orgs.description: A Yogyakarta new-media art lab known for its Micronation/Macronation biotech projects and DIY science with local communities.
orgs.description_zh: 日惹的新媒体艺术实验室，以 Micronation/Macronation 生物技术项目和社区 DIY 科学闻名。

orgs.name: Mediamatic
orgs.description: An Amsterdam art centre with a biotech lab, fermentation kitchen and aquaponics greenhouse, running workshops on mycelium and bio art.
orgs.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的艺术中心，设有生物技术实验室、发酵厨房和鱼菜共生温室，举办菌丝体和生物艺术工作坊。

orgs.name: Biofaction
orgs.description: A Vienna research and science-communication company that runs projects on synthetic biology, xenobiology and art, including the Bio:Fiction film festival.
orgs.description_zh: 维也纳的研究与科学传播公司，开展合成生物学、异种生物学与艺术相关项目，包括 Bio:Fiction 电影节。

orgs.name: Center for PostNatural History
orgs.description: A Pittsburgh museum of organisms intentionally altered by humans, from lab mice to genetically engineered fish.
orgs.description_zh: 匹兹堡的一家博物馆，收藏被人类有意改造过的生物，从实验小鼠到转基因鱼。

orgs.name: KONTEJNER
orgs.description: A Zagreb bureau for contemporary art practice that curates the Touch Me festival and exhibitions on the body, science and technology, including bio art.
orgs.description_zh: 萨格勒布的当代艺术实践机构，策划 Touch Me 艺术节以及关于身体、科学与技术（包括生物艺术）的展览。

orgs.name: Transnatural
orgs.description: An Amsterdam gallery and cultural hub for art and design that merges nature and technology, from biomaterials to living installations.
orgs.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的画廊与文化中心，展示融合自然与技术的艺术和设计，从生物材料到活体装置。

orgs.name: Institute for Postnatural Studies
orgs.description: A Madrid centre for artistic research that runs courses, residencies and publications questioning the idea of nature in the post-natural era.
orgs.description_zh: 马德里的艺术研究中心，通过课程、驻留和出版物反思“后自然”时代的自然观念。

orgs.name: Next Nature
orgs.description: An Amsterdam organisation that explores how technology becomes a 'next nature' through exhibitions, speculative projects and public debate.
orgs.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的机构，通过展览、思辨项目和公共讨论，探讨技术如何成为“下一种自然”。

orgs.name: Makery
orgs.description: A bilingual online media outlet on labs, makers, DIY biology and art-science, covering hackerspaces and community labs worldwide.
orgs.description_zh: 双语在线媒体，报道实验室、创客、DIY 生物学和艺术与科学，关注全球的黑客空间与社区实验室。

orgs.name: Bio Art Ethics (BEAK)
orgs.description: An initiative that offers ethical review and consulting for bio art projects, filling a gap left by institutional review boards.
orgs.description_zh: 为生物艺术项目提供伦理评估和咨询的组织，弥补机构伦理审查的空白。

orgs.name: Open Fung
orgs.description: An art and science network around fungi that publishes, organises events and partnered with Biodesign Challenge on a fungi track.
orgs.description_zh: 围绕真菌的艺术与科学网络，出版刊物、组织活动，并与 Biodesign Challenge 合作开设真菌赛道。

orgs.name: YCAM (Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media)
orgs.description: A Japanese art centre whose YCAM Bio Research programme runs a biolab, food and DNA workshops and art commissions with living systems.
orgs.description_zh: 日本的艺术中心，其 YCAM Bio Research 项目设有生物实验室，举办食物和 DNA 工作坊，并委约与活体系统合作的作品。

orgs.name: Hackteria
orgs.description: A global network for open-source biological art, sharing DIY lab tools, wiki tutorials and nomadic workshops across Europe and Asia.
orgs.description_zh: 开源生物艺术的全球网络，分享 DIY 实验工具、维基教程，并在欧洲和亚洲举办游牧式工作坊。

orgs.name: DIYbio.org
orgs.description: The founding network of the do-it-yourself biology movement, with a mailing list, safety discussions and a world directory of local groups.
orgs.description_zh: DIY 生物学运动的发起网络，提供邮件列表和安全讨论，并维护全球本地小组目录。

orgs.name: Genspace
orgs.description: A Brooklyn community biology lab, one of the first, offering classes, open lab access and art-science programmes to the public.
orgs.description_zh: 布鲁克林的社区生物实验室，最早的社区实验室之一，向公众提供课程、开放实验室和艺术科学项目。

orgs.name: BioCurious
orgs.description: A Bay Area community biology lab where members run open projects, classes and meetups.
orgs.description_zh: 旧金山湾区的社区生物实验室，会员在这里开展开放项目、课程和聚会。

orgs.name: Counter Culture Labs
orgs.description: An Oakland community lab for citizen science and biohacking, home of the Real Vegan Cheese and Open Insulin projects.
orgs.description_zh: 奥克兰的公民科学与生物黑客社区实验室，是 Real Vegan Cheese 和 Open Insulin 项目的发源地。

orgs.name: Baltimore Underground Science Space (BUGSS)
orgs.description: A Baltimore community lab offering biology classes, an iGEM team and art-science events for the public.
orgs.description_zh: 巴尔的摩的社区实验室，为公众提供生物课程、iGEM 团队和艺术科学活动。

orgs.name: BosLab
orgs.description: A Boston-area community biology lab run by volunteers, with classes and member projects.
orgs.description_zh: 波士顿地区由志愿者运营的社区生物实验室，提供课程并支持会员项目。

orgs.name: SoundBio Lab
orgs.description: A Seattle community biology lab offering workshops, open lab nights and a community iGEM team.
orgs.description_zh: 西雅图的社区生物实验室，提供工作坊、开放实验室夜和社区 iGEM 团队。

orgs.name: Open Science Network Society
orgs.description: A Vancouver nonprofit with a community science lab, outreach and mentoring to bring hands-on science to the public.
orgs.description_zh: 温哥华的非营利组织，拥有社区科学实验室，通过推广和导师计划让公众亲手做科学。

orgs.name: London Biohackspace
orgs.description: A volunteer-run community biology lab in London where members do open projects and host workshops.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦由志愿者运营的社区生物实验室，会员开展开放项目并举办工作坊。

orgs.name: Biologigaragen
orgs.description: A Copenhagen community biology lab for citizen science and open biotech projects.
orgs.description_zh: 哥本哈根的社区生物实验室，支持公民科学和开放生物技术项目。

orgs.name: Hackuarium
orgs.description: A Swiss community lab near Lausanne for DIY biology, open hardware and citizen science projects.
orgs.description_zh: 洛桑附近的瑞士社区实验室，从事 DIY 生物学、开源硬件和公民科学项目。

orgs.name: Bionyfiken
orgs.description: The Swedish biohacking association, which runs community lab activities, workshops and events.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞典生物黑客协会，组织社区实验室活动、工作坊和聚会。

orgs.name: DIYBCN Biohackers
orgs.description: A Barcelona biohacker community that runs open workshops and projects in DIY biology.
orgs.description_zh: 巴塞罗那的生物黑客社群，开展 DIY 生物学开放工作坊和项目。

orgs.name: BIOOK
orgs.description: A Basque social enterprise and nonprofit that brings DIY biology to citizens through workshops, kits and a podcast.
orgs.description_zh: 巴斯克地区的社会企业和非营利组织，通过工作坊、套件和播客把 DIY 生物学带给普通市民。

orgs.name: Open BioLab Brussels
orgs.description: An open biology lab at Erasmus University College Brussels for students, citizens and makers to experiment with biotech.
orgs.description_zh: 布鲁塞尔 Erasmus 应用科技大学的开放生物实验室，供学生、市民和创客进行生物技术实验。

orgs.name: BioClub Tokyo
orgs.description: A Tokyo community lab and meetup for biology, art and design, founded with Loftwork and FabCafe.
orgs.description_zh: 东京的生物、艺术与设计社区实验室和聚会，与 Loftwork 和 FabCafe 合作创办。

orgs.name: Genomic Pub
orgs.description: A Korean knowledge-sharing community for biology beginners and experts, running talks and DIY bio activities.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国的生物学知识分享社群，面向初学者和专业人士，举办讲座和 DIY 生物活动。

orgs.name: Global Community Bio Summit
orgs.description: A yearly summit, first hosted at the MIT Media Lab, that gathers community biology labs, biohackers and bioartists from around the world.
orgs.description_zh: 每年举办的峰会，最初在 MIT 媒体实验室举行，汇聚全球社区生物实验室、生物黑客和生物艺术家。

orgs.name: Open Insulin Foundation
orgs.description: A community biotech project that develops open protocols to produce affordable insulin at small scale.
orgs.description_zh: 社区生物技术项目，开发开放的小规模生产方案，让胰岛素更便宜。

orgs.name: Just One Giant Lab (JOGL)
orgs.description: An open research platform, co-founded by a La Paillasse founder, that connects distributed volunteers to solve science problems together.
orgs.description_zh: 开放研究平台，由 La Paillasse 的创始人之一参与创办，把分散各地的志愿者连接起来共同解决科学问题。

orgs.name: Gathering for Open Science Hardware (GOSH)
orgs.description: A global community that promotes open-source scientific hardware, including low-cost lab tools used by community biology labs.
orgs.description_zh: 推广开源科学硬件的全球社群，其中包括社区生物实验室常用的低成本实验工具。

orgs.name: Biohacking Village
orgs.description: A nonprofit community and event at DEF CON on biohacking, medical device security and open biology.
orgs.description_zh: 在 DEF CON 大会举办的非营利社群和活动，关注生物黑客、医疗设备安全和开放生物学。

orgs.name: OpenWetWare
orgs.description: A wiki where biologists and community labs share protocols, lab notebooks and course material openly.
orgs.description_zh: 生物学者和社区实验室公开分享实验方案、实验记录和课程材料的维基网站。

orgs.name: Amino Labs
orgs.description: A company that makes beginner-friendly genetic engineering kits and mini-labs for schools and the public.
orgs.description_zh: 为学校和公众制作入门级基因工程套件和迷你实验室的公司。

orgs.name: Bento Lab
orgs.description: A London company that makes a portable DNA lab combining PCR, centrifuge and gel electrophoresis for education and fieldwork.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦公司，生产集 PCR、离心机和凝胶电泳于一体的便携 DNA 实验室，用于教学和野外工作。

orgs.name: The ODIN
orgs.description: Josiah Zayner's company selling DIY CRISPR and genetic engineering kits, a flashpoint in debates about home biohacking.
orgs.description_zh: Josiah Zayner 的公司，销售 DIY CRISPR 和基因工程套件，是家庭生物黑客争论的焦点。

orgs.name: Biomaker
orgs.description: A Cambridge-based open-source bioinstrumentation initiative that funds and documents low-cost hardware projects for biology.
orgs.description_zh: 剑桥的开源生物仪器项目，资助并记录面向生物学的低成本硬件项目。

orgs.name: How To Grow (Almost) Anything
orgs.description: An MIT course on synthetic biology, open to remote nodes worldwide, that teaches students to design and build with living organisms.
orgs.description_zh: MIT 的合成生物学课程，全球各地可远程节点参与，教学生用活体生物进行设计和建造。

orgs.name: iGEM Foundation
orgs.description: The international Genetically Engineered Machine competition, where student teams design synthetic biology projects each year.
orgs.description_zh: 国际基因工程机器大赛的主办方，每年学生团队设计合成生物学项目参赛。

orgs.name: iGEM Registry of Standard Biological Parts
orgs.description: An open collection of standardised genetic parts (BioBricks) contributed and used by iGEM teams.
orgs.description_zh: 开放的标准化遗传元件（BioBricks）库，由 iGEM 团队贡献并使用。

orgs.name: BioBricks Foundation
orgs.description: A nonprofit that promoted open, standardised genetic parts and legal tools such as the Open Material Transfer Agreement; its old site is no longer active.
orgs.description_zh: 倡导开放、标准化遗传元件的非营利组织，推出了开放材料转让协议等法律工具；原网站已停用。

orgs.name: SynBioBeta
orgs.description: The main industry conference and community for synthetic biology startups and investors.
orgs.description_zh: 合成生物学初创公司与投资者的主要行业会议和社群。

orgs.name: Engineering Biology Research Consortium (EBRC)
orgs.description: A US consortium of researchers and companies that writes roadmaps and policy guidance for engineering biology.
orgs.description_zh: 由研究者和公司组成的美国联盟，为工程生物学编写路线图和政策指南。

orgs.name: BioBuilder Educational Foundation
orgs.description: A nonprofit that brings synthetic biology into high schools through teacher training, a textbook and lab activities.
orgs.description_zh: 把合成生物学带进高中的非营利组织，提供教师培训、教材和实验活动。

orgs.name: Build-a-Cell
orgs.description: An open international community of researchers working to build synthetic living cells from non-living parts.
orgs.description_zh: 开放的国际研究者社群，致力于用非生命组分构建合成活细胞。

orgs.name: IndieBio
orgs.description: A biotech startup accelerator run by SOSV that has funded many biomaterials, food and synthetic biology companies.
orgs.description_zh: SOSV 旗下的生物技术初创加速器，资助过许多生物材料、食品和合成生物学公司。

orgs.name: Global Biofoundry Alliance
orgs.description: An alliance of public biofoundries worldwide that share automated methods and standards for engineering biology.
orgs.description_zh: 全球公共生物铸造厂的联盟，共享工程生物学的自动化方法和标准。

orgs.name: SynBio Africa
orgs.description: An organisation that builds synthetic biology capacity in Africa through training, research and policy dialogue.
orgs.description_zh: 通过培训、研究和政策对话在非洲建设合成生物学能力的组织。

orgs.name: Cortical Labs
orgs.description: A Melbourne company that grows human neurons on chips; its DishBrain culture learned to play Pong and it sells the CL1 biological computer.
orgs.description_zh: 墨尔本公司，在芯片上培养人类神经元；其 DishBrain 学会了玩 Pong，并推出 CL1 生物计算机。

orgs.name: FinalSpark
orgs.description: A Swiss company that runs brain organoids on electrode arrays and offers remote access to them through its Neuroplatform.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士公司，在电极阵列上运行脑类器官，并通过 Neuroplatform 提供远程访问。

orgs.name: Koniku
orgs.description: A company that builds sensing devices combining living cells and silicon, aimed at smelling explosives and diseases.
orgs.description_zh: 把活细胞和硅芯片结合在一起制造传感设备的公司，目标是嗅出爆炸物和疾病。

orgs.name: Center for Alternatives to Animal Testing (Johns Hopkins)
orgs.description: A Johns Hopkins centre that develops alternatives to animal testing and, under Thomas Hartung, launched the organoid intelligence research agenda.
orgs.description_zh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的中心，研发替代动物实验的方法；在 Thomas Hartung 领导下提出了“类器官智能”研究议程。

orgs.name: Organoid Intelligence (OI) Community
orgs.description: The community site for organoid intelligence research, which lists founding researchers and resources and runs the International Conference on Organoid Intelligence.
orgs.description_zh: 类器官智能研究的社群网站，列出创始研究者与资源，并主办国际类器官智能会议。

orgs.name: Braingeneers (UC Santa Cruz)
orgs.description: A UC Santa Cruz-led group that builds remote-controlled lab tools to grow, record and train brain organoids over the internet.
orgs.description_zh: 由加州大学圣克鲁兹分校主导的研究组，开发可远程控制的实验工具，通过互联网培养、记录和训练脑类器官。

orgs.name: MaxWell Biosystems
orgs.description: A Swiss maker of high-density microelectrode arrays used to record and stimulate neurons and organoids, including in biocomputing research.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士高密度微电极阵列制造商，其设备用于记录和刺激神经元与类器官，也用于生物计算研究。

orgs.name: 3Brain
orgs.description: A company that makes high-density CMOS microelectrode arrays for recording neural cultures, organoids and retinas.
orgs.description_zh: 生产高密度 CMOS 微电极阵列的公司，用于记录神经培养物、类器官和视网膜。

orgs.name: Unconventional Computing Laboratory (UWE Bristol)
orgs.description: Andrew Adamatzky's lab that computes with slime moulds, fungi, chemical reactions and other unconventional substrates.
orgs.description_zh: Andrew Adamatzky 的实验室，用黏菌、真菌、化学反应等非常规介质做计算。

orgs.name: International Journal of Unconventional Computing
orgs.description: A journal for computing with physical, chemical and biological systems, edited by Andrew Adamatzky.
orgs.description_zh: 发表用物理、化学和生物系统进行计算研究的期刊，由 Andrew Adamatzky 主编。

orgs.name: Natural Computing (Springer)
orgs.description: A Springer journal on computation inspired by or performed with nature, including DNA, molecular and cellular computing.
orgs.description_zh: Springer 期刊，关注受自然启发或借助自然完成的计算，包括 DNA、分子和细胞计算。

orgs.name: Living Machines Conference
orgs.description: A yearly international conference on biomimetic and biohybrid systems, from bio-inspired robots to living-artificial hybrids.
orgs.description_zh: 每年举办的国际会议，关注仿生与生物混合系统，从仿生机器人到活体与人工的混合体。

orgs.name: FUNGAR – Fungal Architectures
orgs.description: An EU-funded project that set out to grow buildings from mycelium that can also sense and compute.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟资助的项目，目标是用菌丝体生长出既能感知又能计算的建筑。

orgs.name: FUNGATERIA
orgs.description: An EU Pathfinder project developing engineered living materials from fungi and bacteria for self-growing, self-repairing structures.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟 Pathfinder 项目，用真菌和细菌开发可自我生长、自我修复的工程化活体材料。

orgs.name: International Society for Artificial Life (ISAL)
orgs.description: The society behind the ALIFE conference and Artificial Life journal, studying life-like behaviour in software, hardware and wetware.
orgs.description_zh: ALIFE 会议和《Artificial Life》期刊背后的学会，研究软件、硬件与湿件中的类生命行为。

orgs.name: Allen Discovery Center at Tufts University
orgs.description: Michael Levin's centre studying how bioelectric signals guide body shape, which co-created xenobots and other synthetic living forms.
orgs.description_zh: Michael Levin 领导的中心，研究生物电信号如何引导身体形态，与合作者共同创造了 xenobot 等合成生命形式。

orgs.name: Institute for Computer Designed Organisms
orgs.description: A research institute by the University of Vermont and Tufts teams behind xenobots that uses AI to design new living machines.
orgs.description_zh: 由佛蒙特大学和塔夫茨大学 xenobot 团队设立的研究所，用人工智能设计新的活体机器。

orgs.name: Molecular Information Systems Lab (University of Washington)
orgs.description: A University of Washington and Microsoft lab that builds systems to store and compute data in DNA.
orgs.description_zh: 华盛顿大学与微软合作的实验室，搭建在 DNA 中存储和计算数据的系统。

orgs.name: DNA Data Storage Alliance (SNIA)
orgs.description: An industry alliance, now part of SNIA, that writes standards and roadmaps for storing digital data in DNA.
orgs.description_zh: 产业联盟，现隶属 SNIA，为在 DNA 中存储数字数据制定标准和路线图。

orgs.name: Biomemory
orgs.description: A French company developing DNA data storage appliances for data centres, using biological production of DNA.
orgs.description_zh: 法国公司，开发面向数据中心的 DNA 数据存储设备，采用生物方式生产 DNA。

orgs.name: ISNSCE and the DNA Computing Conference
orgs.description: The society that runs the yearly International Conference on DNA Computing and Molecular Programming.
orgs.description_zh: 每年举办“DNA 计算与分子编程国际会议”的学会。

orgs.name: Molecular Programming Project
orgs.description: A multi-university research effort that develops the theory and tools to program molecules such as DNA to compute and build.
orgs.description_zh: 跨大学的研究计划，开发让 DNA 等分子进行计算和自组装的理论与工具。

orgs.name: Qian Lab (Caltech)
orgs.description: Lulu Qian's Caltech lab that builds DNA circuits and molecular neural networks that recognise patterns.
orgs.description_zh: Lulu Qian 在加州理工学院的实验室，构建能识别模式的 DNA 电路和分子神经网络。
